title: LlamaIndex Pipeline
description: A document ingestion pipeline (index) in LlamaCloud that processes, embeds, and indexes documents for retrieval in RAG applications.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project the pipeline belongs to.

status.description: Current processing status of the pipeline.

embedding_model.description: Name of the embedding model used for vectorization.

sync_interval.description: Scheduled sync frequency in seconds. Zero means manual sync only.

data_sources.description: Data sources connected to this pipeline for automatic ingestion.

data_sinks.description: Data sinks where processed content is stored.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the pipeline was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the pipeline was last updated.

DataSource.description: A data source that provides documents for automatic ingestion into a pipeline.

id.description: Unique identifier of the data source.

name.description: Human-readable name of the data source.

source_type.description: Type of the data source (e.g., document, table, api, database, web).

project_id.description: Identifier of the project the data source belongs to.

config.description: Configuration specific to the data source type.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the data source was created.

DataSink.description: A data sink that receives processed and embedded content, such as a vector database.

id.description: Unique identifier of the data sink.

name.description: Human-readable name of the data sink.

sink_type.description: Type of the data sink (e.g., vector_store).

config.description: Configuration specific to the data sink type.
